project_requirements: Professional company website for Mzantsi Transmissions, specialising in heavy-duty transmission repairs, servicing and testing for heavy-duty and on-highway equipment. The demo should present the company, its transmission expertise, services, supported brands and equipment, and contact details.
project_notes: Initial demo project for Mzantsi Transmissions. The company is an established transmission and gearbox specialist based in Alrode South, Alberton. Known areas of work include heavy-duty transmission repairs, servicing and testing, including ZF transmission dyno testing. Industry information references brands and equipment including ZF, Allison, Clark, Funk, Bell, Terex, Hitachi and John Deere. Further services, company information, branding, photographs and contact details are to be confirmed with the client.
